source: ADD-RS items per Nazerian 2018 ADvISED (PMID 29030346); clinical vignette written for this study

add_rs_items.category: High-risk conditions (Marfan or connective tissue disease, family history of aortic disease, known aortic valve disease, known thoracic aneurysm, previous aortic manipulation)
High-risk pain features (abrupt onset, severe intensity, ripping or tearing)
add_rs_items.note: abrupt onset and severe intensity (onset fact)

add_rs_items.category: High-risk examination features (pulse deficit or systolic BP differential, focal neurologic deficit with pain, new aortic regurgitation murmur with pain, hypotension or shock)

add_rs_note: ADD-RS 1 (one point from the pain category). Hypertension is a common risk factor but not an ADD-RS item. ADD-RS is not stated in any note. Cutoff stated in both results is 500 ng/mL. The prior used for the target is the ADD-RS = 1 stratum prevalence 96/1071 (Nazerian p. 253-254); the D-dimer LRs are cohort-wide. The clinician line (acute aortic syndrome among the leading considerations) and 'diaphoretic' are not ADD-RS items; they are deliberate realism facts, identical across conditions and polarities (L6).
surface_key_note: Surface keys: V, N, B, S, or NB (N and B), NBS. First string is what the templates render; any string counts for the check. Matching is case-insensitive.
